learning.title: How learning works at Bilmont
learning.sub: AI + Educational Technology + Individual Guidance — three pillars that complement each other and cannot be separated.

pillars.title: AI-Powered Personalization
pillars.desc: Each student's learning path, pace and interests are tracked individually. AI is the teacher's assistant — it provides the data; the teacher makes the decision.

pillars.title: STEM, Robotics & EdTech
pillars.desc: Digital literacy, coding and robotics workshops from grade 1. Children grow up not as consumers but as creators of technology.

pillars.title: Guidance & SEL Support
pillars.desc: Scientific class-based assessment with the EduTech CPT toolkit. Multiple intelligences, learning styles and exam anxiety are all monitored.

compass.label: Signature tool
compass.title: Development Compass
compass.desc: Holistic tracking across 6 dimensions for every child. AI generates, counselors interpret, families understand.

interior.title: A space made for learning
interior.sub: Spacious 50 m² classrooms, full of light and air, with thoughtful zones for study, play and rest. Every detail is designed so children feel calm, safe and curious — a place where the wish to learn something new is born every day.

director.name: Mitin Kylych
director.quote: Every child is seen. No one slips through.
director.bio: Bilmont is not just a school — it's a laboratory showing what's possible in Central Asia. We're building a new-generation school where children become self-aware, love learning, think in multiple languages, and grow with 21st-century skills.

contact.title: Let's build Bishkek's best school together.
contact.sub: Would you like to be one of Bilmont's founding families? Write to us — every meeting takes no more than 30 minutes.
